{ "html_url": "https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/pull/57", "number": 57, "title": "[Cursor] Replace hand-rolled review parser with Zod", "body": " ## Why `parseReviewDocument` was ~500 lines of field-by-field checks next to `types.ts` and `review.schema.json`. Three copies of the same document. AGENTS.md already says to parse at the boundary with the schema as the source of truth. ## Work - One Zod 4 schema for the review document. `ReviewDocument` is inferred from it. The hand-rolled `requiredString` / `extraKeys` stack is gone. - `src/schema/review.schema.json` is generated from that schema (`pnpm generate:schema`). `pnpm sync:skill` still copies it. Drift is a unit test. - Cross-field rules stay as refinements: duplicate ids, `dependsOn`, citations, pr-comment fields, transcript URLs, sources vs legacy `tickets`. - Unknown `patch` and unknown source ids still fail. Other CLI error strings can differ. - Zod is a runtime dependency. `pack-smoke` allows that one package and still refuses Pierre / UI libraries. Out of scope: `parseUnifiedDiff`, Pierre glue, image review, HTTP, git wrappers. ## Review https://67qzjga9.vibedrop.site Posted by Cursor Grok 4.6 [cursor-grok-4.6]
